description: This file implements functions for decrypting media buffers and transforming capabilities in the OpenCDM adapter, including session management and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_ex
methods.description: Performs decryption of a session buffer with additional parameters, logs error if session is null.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt
methods.description: Wrapper around the extended decrypt function, simplifies call without caps.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer using a session, adds protection meta, and handles errors.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_transform_caps
methods.description: Transforms or processes GstCaps, currently returns success without modification.
